Click 'Send message'.
When the answer finishes, check that each paragraph is separate with space between them, as Expected says.

S20.22.note: Streaming rendering is shown only while the reply streams; it has no control of its own.

Click 'Send message'.
Watch the answer while it types: headings and bold text should show as formatted, not as raw # or ** marks.
When it finishes, compare with the same text in the final answer, as Expected says.

S20.23.note: The fence closing is handled in packages/platform/utils/src/markdownSource.ts (closeUnterminatedCodeFence); a streaming-only effect.

S20.26.needs: a signed-in account, a mouse or trackpad

Click 'Send message'.
Press the mouse at the start of the heading and drag down past the list and into the code block.
Check the selection stays continuous across all the blocks, with no gaps, as Expected says. Then click 'Copy message' to see the copied text.

S20.27.needs: a conversation with an answer (any signed-in account that has one)
S20.27.note: Command+F is handled in apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/ChatMessageList.tsx and accepts Command or Ctrl; the match count display was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open a conversation whose answer has several paragraphs and repeated words.
Press Command+F. The "Search messages..." field opens and is selected.
Type a word that appears in the answer.
Look at the rendered answer: the matching words should be highlighted in the text itself, not only in the search field.
Press Enter for the next match and Shift+Enter for the previous one, or use "Go to next match" and "Go to previous match"; check that the view moves to each match.
Press Escape or click "Close search" to end the search.
S20.27.where: Open a conversation with an answer > press Command+F (Ctrl+F also works) > the "Search messages..." field at the top of the message list

S20.28.needs: a conversation with a formatted answer (heading, list, table, code, math)
S20.28.note: The menu shows only when the conversation has messages and a title; the header button's visible name is only the aria label "Conversation options"; the export button label is built as "Export" plus the format name (EnhancedExportDialog.tsx line 286), and export builds the file from the conversation's Markdown.
steps: Open a conversation with an answer that has a heading, a list, a table, a code block and a math formula.
Click the Conversation options button at the top of the chat, then click Print.
In the print preview, compare the headings, lists, table, code and math with the screen.
Cancel the print. Click the Conversation options button, then click Export….
Choose PDF in Export Chat History, click the Export PDF button, open the downloaded file and compare its headings, lists, table, code and math with the screen.
S20.28.where: Open a conversation > the Conversation options button at the top of the chat (icon button, no visible text) > Print, or Export… > Export Chat History dialog > Export PDF

S20.29.needs: a keyboard that types Arabic or Hebrew
S20.29.note: No control exists; the message text sets dir="auto" (apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx:2839), so direction follows each message's text.
steps: Type a message in Arabic or Hebrew in the message box and send it.
Ask the assistant for a short answer written in Arabic or Hebrew.
Look at the user and assistant bubbles: the text should start from the right edge and be right-aligned, with the direction following the text.
S20.29.where: Any chat message that contains Arabic or Hebrew text (sent by you or written by the assistant)

S20.30.note: Unknown code languages fall back to plain text (apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx and packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/MarkdownContent.tsx:677), and unknown interactive cards show a fallback headline (apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/InteractiveCardBlock.tsx:229); no tester-facing trigger for those was confirmed.
steps: Ask the assistant for a Mermaid flowchart diagram in an answer.
If the diagram fails to draw, look inside the answer for the text "This diagram could not be drawn".
Check that the diagram source is still shown below that text and that the rest of the message is still readable.
